title: Hotels - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue in the Hotels market is projected to reach US$372.06bn in 2026.
Revenue is expected to show an annual growth rate (CAGR 2026-2031) of 4.27%, resulting in a projected market volume of US$458.68bn by 2031.
In the Hotels market market, the number of users is expected to amount to 1.13bn users by 2031.
The average revenue per user (ARPU) is expected to amount to US$409.03.
